verdict.rationale: The archived docs described a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, but they never claimed that everything in the UI could be done through the API. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, accounts and API keys stopped working on 2026-10-31 and the docs tree was removed. What remains is an undocumented registry JSON endpoint and a CLI, neither of which shows UI parity, so there is no current evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
